notes: Parts 11-15: 50 groups processed into 53 rows. Merged groups: 'reg syncona' + 'omass therapeutics' are the same OMass $310M Series C (one row, both candidate ids). Expanded: 'homeward' into two rows ($120M Series D equity + $330M asset-backed debt), 'arda' into two rows ($160M Series A + prior $72M seed disclosed in the same release, seed date unknown so it carries the announcement date), 'polsky 10 pyxis' round-up into three rows (Pyxis Oncology public offering, Thrixel $3M, Inomagen $2.9M NIH SBIR grant; dates default to the newsletter date). 'deepseek leads 400 million' resolved via lookup to Winverse AI: the $400M in headlines is the post-money valuation, round size undisclosed ('tens of millions'), deal reported as not final. Capitolis row records the $120M Series E only; the remaining ~$100M of the $220M total is venture debt from First Citizens, Hercules Capital and Pinegrove (not in feed text, so not listed as investors). Otter.ai $320M is a non-equity growth investment from General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund; recorded as Growth with that caveat. Several looked-up rounds were announced before October (Island 2026-09-24, Celero 2026-09-08, Varda 2026-09-30, Fever 2026-09-17, Mal reported Jan/May 2026 with the feed date 2026-10-04 kept as fallback because sources conflict). Fever is Madrid-founded with a New York office; hq_country set to US under the dual-HQ rule with reduced confidence. Arda HQ conflicts between San Francisco and Alameda (San Francisco used). Lookups used: 22 of 25 (8 WebSearch + 11 WebFetch, 4 of which returned 403, + 3 follow-up WebSearch for Capitolis AI claim, Celero HQ, Arda HQ). Evidence spans for Homeward, Island, Celero, Fever, Mal, Arena and Varda come from the fetched/searched source URLs listed in source_urls rather than the feed text; Island's additional participants (Sequoia, Prysm, Coatue, Insight, Cyberstarts, Georgian, J.P. Morgan Growth Equity, G Squared, Alta Park, Squarepoint) and Mal's lead BlueFive Capital appeared only in search summaries, so Island's extra names were left out and BlueFive is included with its summary span. SmartCentres $450M debentures assumed CAD and converted; Canyon NZ$300M converted; Ironbark $255.9M currency not stated (Australian company). Credit facilities for private companies (WTEC, Lydian) are kept as Debt with no exclude_reason; securitizations, CLOs, project finance, refinancings and public-company notes are excluded.
